original_description: AdKraft turns product photos into finished video ads. Give it a product name, a short description and a product photo (attach it in the chat or paste a link), and it writes the script, generates the footage with a voiceover in any of 16 languages and hands back an MP4 you can post, in portrait, square or landscape, usually in under a minute. Ads are made on your own AdKraft account and use its credits; new accounts start with free credits, and you can check the balance or list the ads you have made without leaving the chat.
summary_ja: 商品写真と説明からナレーション付きの動画広告を作り、MP4を受け取る。
limitations: AdKraftアカウントのクレジットを使用し、新規アカウントには無料分があるとの説明。実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
